seo.title: Track your report
seo.description: Check the status of an anonymous report using your report number and password. No login or personal information required.
seo.reportDescription: Status and activity timeline for anonymous report #{{number}}.

page.introAccount: Open a report filed under your account with its report number.
page.introAnonymous: Track your report securely using the credentials provided when you submitted. No login or personal information required.

form.title: Track your report
form.introAccount: Enter the report number to check its status. You are signed in, so no report password is needed.
form.introAnonymous: Enter your credentials to check the status of your anonymous report. No login required.
form.filedAccount: We have filled in your report number — open it below.
form.filedAnonymous: We have filled in your report number. Enter the password the assistant read out to you to open it.
form.reportNumberHint: The 8-digit number provided when you submitted your report
form.signedInAs: Signed in as {{account}}. Reports filed under this account open without a report password.
form.reportPasswordHint: The password you created when submitting your report

errors.notOnAccount: No report with that number was found on your account. If you filed it anonymously, sign out to track it with its password.
errors.enterBoth: Please enter both report number and password
errors.couldNotOpen: We could not open that report. Please try again.

toast.draftFound: Draft found! Continue where you left off.
toast.loginToMessage: You must be logged in to send messages. Please create an account.
toast.copyFailed: Could not copy — please select the credentials and copy them manually.
toast.copyTextFailed: Could not copy — please select the text and copy it manually.

features.title: What you can do with tracking:

notice.title: Important: save your credentials
notice.text: Lost credentials cannot be recovered for anonymous reports. Make sure to store your report number and password in a secure location.

details.title: Report #{{number}}
details.anonymousText: You're viewing this report in read-only mode. To send messages and receive notifications, <lnk>create a free account</lnk>.
details.twoWayText: Create an account to send secure messages to investigators and receive instant notifications.
details.unlockText: Get advanced tracking, messaging, and notifications with a free account.
details.signIn: Already have an account? Sign in
details.secureText: This report is encrypted and only accessible with your unique credentials. Never share your report number or password.
details.supportText: Our support team is here to help

reportPage.title: Report details
reportPage.subtitle: View all details of your submitted report
reportPage.notFoundText: The report you are looking for does not exist or you do not have permission to view it.
reportPage.keepSecure: Keep your report number and password secure. You'll need them to check updates.

tour.infoText: The title and any form data you submitted with this report.
tour.statusText: Track where your report stands and how it has been prioritized.
tour.timelineText: See when the report was submitted and when it was last updated.
tour.filesText: Download any files you attached as evidence.
tour.messagesText: Communicate directly and securely with the compliance team here.
tour.privacyText: Your identity stays protected and all communication is end-to-end encrypted.
tour.nextText: Track another report, submit a new one, or print this page for your records.
